title_sq: Ne Astir, Shitet Apartament 2+1, Me Planimetri Te Rregullt!!!
description_sq: Ne Astir, Shitet Apartament 2+1, Me Planimetri Te Rregullt!!! title_en: In Astir, 2+1 apartment for sale, with regular layout!!!
description_en: In Astir, 2+1 apartment for sale, with regular layout!!! The property is located on the 4th floor of a well-managed building, and has a floor area of ​​94.4 m2, of which the net area is 81.4 m2. It is organized by the distribution corridor, the living room together with the cooking corner, the matrimonial room together with the wardrobe, the children's room, the toilet and the balcony. The orientation of the property is East. The property has regular mortgage documentation. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable and peaceful life.
